lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The same afternoon, from the other hill.|Here nobody counts fords. They count people.
lines.text: The same afternoon, from the other hill. Here nobody counts fords. They count people.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Maelis, the horns. Every farm in the|valley comes up this hill before dark.
lines.text: Maelis, the horns. Every farm in the valley comes up this hill before dark.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: And the ford? Malrik will want his ford.
lines.text: And the ford? Malrik will want his ford.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Let him want it. A ford is water and|stones. Those farms are families.
lines.text: Let him want it. A ford is water and stones. Those farms are families.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I'll take the east slope. If Torvald crosses,|he can explain himself to a fire.
lines.text: I'll take the east slope. If Torvald crosses, he can explain himself to a fire.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: Up the hill, to the golden tree!|Leave the goats!
lines.text: Up the hill! Leave the... leave the goats! Up to the golden tree!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. You are herding sheep while|I take your river. That is very you.
lines.text: Ysolde. You are herding sheep while I take your river. That is very you.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Sheep come back in spring, Malrik. So do I.
lines.text: Sheep come back in spring, Malrik. So do I.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Through the ford, little ones.|Slow is fine. Slow is alive.
lines.text: Through the ford, little ones. Slow is fine. Slow is alive.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. Go home. I have no|quarrel with your farms.
lines.text: Ysolde. Go home. I have no quarrel with your farms.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Then why is your winter|standing in them, Torvald?
lines.text: Then why is your winter standing in them, Torvald?

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: The green one keeps a tree, Bishop.|A golden tree. HIS tree. Take it.
lines.text: The green one keeps a tree, Bishop. A golden tree. HIS tree. Take it.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: One thing at a time. The ford first.|Then we will talk about trees.
lines.text: One thing at a time. The ford first. Then we will talk about trees.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Smoke over the farms. Whoever was|still there is not coming up the hill.
lines.text: Smoke over the farms. Whoever was still there is not coming up the hill.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The evening horn. Malrik's whole|host comes down to the water.
lines.text: The evening horn. Malrik's whole host comes down to the water.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The ford's gone. Fall back to the|stones and the standards. Nobody runs.
lines.text: The ford's gone. Fall back to the stones and the standards. Nobody runs.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Let them have the water. Everyone to the|foot of the hill. Nobody passes the tree.
lines.text: Let them have the water. Everyone to the foot of the hill. Nobody passes the tree.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The ford held till the horn! Ysolde,|that was almost reckless. I'm proud of you.
lines.text: The ford held till the horn! Ysolde, that was almost reckless. I'm proud of you.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They have a standard. Let them carry it.|Banners are light. Hills are not.
lines.text: They have a standard. Let them carry it. Banners are light. Hills are not.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Ysolde! Torvald brought mortars to my well.|I could use some thorns over here!
lines.text: Ysolde! Torvald brought mortars to my well. I could use some thorns over here!

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: The Bishop wanted a look at the tree.|I came to look first.
lines.text: The Bishop wanted a look at the tree. I came to look first.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Behind us! The wood has a knife in it!
lines.text: Behind us! The wood has a knife in it!

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: There it is. His tree. Burn it,|and he feels it in the deep.
lines.text: There it is. His tree. Burn it, and he feels it in the deep.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Ysolde! Step aside. I only want the tree.
lines.text: Ysolde! Step aside. I only want the tree.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Everyone who ever wanted this tree said "only".
lines.text: Everyone who ever wanted this tree said "only".

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I came for a ford, Bishop.|Not for his tree. My host stops here.
lines.text: I came for a ford, Bishop. Not for his tree. My host stops here.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Lightning, Bishop. Since before|you were born. Off the hill.
lines.text: Lightning, Bishop. Since before you were born. Off the hill.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: A horn's down. The other one|will have to sing for both.
lines.text: A horn's down. The other one will have to sing for both.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Ten families under the tree.|The goats, mostly, made it too.
lines.text: Ten families under the tree. The goats, mostly, made it too.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: That's twenty, my lady!|The tree's getting crowded.
lines.text: That's... twenty, my lady. Twenty! The tree's getting... crowded.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Everyone. Every last one.|Now we only have to keep them.
lines.text: Everyone. Every last one. Now we only have to keep them.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The ford is his. The hill is ours,|and every family on it, and the tree.
lines.text: The ford is his. The hill is ours, and every family on it, and the tree.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: He'll call it a victory, you know.
lines.text: He'll call it a victory, you know.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Let him. Something always|grows back. It will not stop.
lines.text: Let him. Something always grows back. It will not stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Night fell. The golden tree still stood, and|everyone who made it up the hill slept under it.
lines.text: Night fell. The golden tree still stood, and everyone who made it up the hill slept under it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Keep them... under the tree... Maelis...
lines.text: Keep them... under the tree... Maelis...

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The Master's tree... It's gone dark.
lines.text: The Master's tree... It's gone dark.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Too many. We were too slow,|and the valley is empty.
lines.text: Too many. We were too slow, and the valley is empty.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The forest is not done with me. Neither am I.
lines.text: The forest is not done with me. Neither am I.
